mapper.select: SELECT a.ApptID as apptId, a.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, a.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, a.ApptTime as apptTime, a.ApptStatus as apptStatus, e.EmpName as empName, a.CreateTime as createTime FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN store s ON a.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.EmpID = e.EmpID WHERE a.UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY a.CreateTime DESC

SELECT a.ApptID as apptId, a.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, p.Breed as breed, p.Gender as gender, p.BirthDate as birthDate, p.VaccineStatus as vaccineStatus, p.Remarks as remarks, p.AllergyDrug as allergyDrug, p.MedicalHistory as medicalHistory, a.UserID as userId, u.UserName as userName, u.Phone as userPhone, a.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, s.StoreAddress as storeAddress, s.StorePhone as storePhone, a.EmpID as empId, a.ApptTime as apptTime, a.ApptStatus as apptStatus, e.EmpName as empName, e.Position as empPosition, a.DiagnoseStatus as diagnoseStatus, a.DiagnoseDesc as diagnoseDesc, a.CreateTime as createTime FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON a.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN store s ON a.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.EmpID = e.EmpID WHERE a.ApptID = #{apptId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE DiagnoseStatus = '待诊断' AND ApptStatus NOT IN ('已取消', '已拒绝')

SELECT a.ApptID as apptId, a.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, p.Breed as breed, p.Gender as gender, p.BirthDate as birthDate, p.VaccineStatus as vaccineStatus, p.Remarks as remarks, p.AllergyDrug as allergyDrug, p.MedicalHistory as medicalHistory, a.UserID as userId, u.UserName as userName, u.Phone as userPhone, a.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, s.StoreAddress as storeAddress, s.StorePhone as storePhone, a.EmpID as empId, e.EmpName as empName, e.Position as empPosition, a.ApptTime as apptTime, a.ApptStatus as apptStatus, a.DiagnoseStatus as diagnoseStatus, a.DiagnoseDesc as diagnoseDesc, a.CreateTime as createTime FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON a.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN store s ON a.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.EmpID = e.EmpID WHERE 1=1
AND a.DiagnoseStatus = #{diagnoseStatus}
AND ( p.PetName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.UserName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.DiagnoseDesc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY a.CreateTime DESC

SELECT e.EmpID FROM employee e LEFT JOIN appointment a ON e.EmpID = a.EmpID AND a.ApptStatus = '待确认' WHERE e.StoreID = #{storeId} AND e.Position = '医生' GROUP BY e.EmpID ORDER BY COUNT(a.ApptID) ASC LIMIT 1
